info.title: Lords Business External Service API
info.description: External service for Lords Business admin application

get.summary: Confirm whether divisions exist for a given date
get.description: Returns true if divisions exist for the given date, otherwise returns false

parameters.name: format
parameters.description:
the required output format
(xml or json)

parameters.name: date
parameters.description:
The date to be checked for the presence of divisions
(yyyy-mm-dd)

get.summary: Get a list of non-sitting days
get.description:
Returns a list of non-sitting days for a given month and year. If a non-sitting period spans more than the given month, and data source is Calendar, non-sitting days for
            the entire period encompassing the given month will be returned.

parameters.name: month
parameters.description: The number of the month for which to return non-sitting days e.g. enter 12 for month of December

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: The year for which to return non-sitting days

parameters.name: format
parameters.description:
the required output format
(xml or json)

parameters.name: dataSource
parameters.description: Source of non sitting days. Default is Calendar. select "PublishedBusiness" to instead return days with no published business.

get.summary: Get next and previous sitting days with items of business
get.description: Get next and previous sitting days which have items of business. If the next or previous sitting date does not have an item of business, null is returned

parameters.name: format
parameters.description:
the required output format
(xml or json)

parameters.name: initialDate
parameters.description:
The date from which to return the previous and next days with items of business
(yyyy-mm-dd)

get.summary: Get a list of Written Questions
get.description: Get a list of Written Questions which meet the specified criteria. Only returns questions which have been published.

get.summary: Get a single Written Question by ID
get.description: Get a single Written Question which has the ID specified. Only returns a question if it has been published.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: The required output format (xml or json)
